hypothesis: 只询问任务目的和手接触可纠正误判；退离跟踪仍推进时按路径分配有界时间可完成原安全路线与归位。
information_gain: 同真实初末态，酒瓶先验触发；灶台独立验证预算修复，不用软件通过代替实际执行。两因素同时改变不能分开归因视觉与控制总体效果。
success_criteria: 正例goal true触发actual_open>0，实测开口；movement>0达到原安全路径终点，原streaming home>0且ready。独立目标/释放/无手接触/归位连续五个actual post样本真；最终两问也通过。
failure_criteria: 正例目的未触发或开爪0停止其依赖，定位触发链；有动作未达效果报告具体阶段，零归位不得称归位失败。负例误触发为错误。
unknown_criteria: 不同SHA、模型null、传输/协议失败记录unknown，不伪造成功。

changed_factors.name: goal_checker
changed_factors.before: 11 model fields; goal AND supported AND at_destination
changed_factors.after: two booleans; explicitly distinguish goal-region handoff from final acceptance; contact/gap cannot alone veto handoff
changed_factors.reason: 落实用户指定条件，无支撑/悬空附加检查

changed_factors.name: retreat_budget
changed_factors.after: min(480,max(120,16*segments+40)); stalled40 samples stops; same waypoint tracking and .004 tolerance
changed_factors.reason: 旧记录每2mm约8-11周期，120仅覆盖14/20点，持续推进误停

changed_factors.name: visual_views
changed_factors.after: place release checks: agent+side+wrist; confirm/home and turn checks: agent+side; latest two timestamps
changed_factors.reason: actual wrist clearly shows bottle across rack slats; previous successful wine check used wrist, current two views repeated false contact assertions despite independent handoff wording; after actual withdrawal wrist still points at bottle on shelf and produced false hold; post-withdraw global views show physical separation. No stale timestamps: both prior images were17.05/17.10 after withdrawal.

changed_factors.name: withdrawal_open_gate
changed_factors.before: must reach standard open within2mm before any retreat
changed_factors.after: total aperture>=90%, each finger>=85%reference, finger speed<=.005 and arm speed<=.02; plan from measured pose; exact2mm standard-open still required before home; not release proof
changed_factors.reason: actual wine opening20 commands reached aperture92.4%, one finger blocked near rack; target remained placed/unheld, exact open-before-escape deadlocks support-contact exit; last wine also showed arm target error .0185rad though speed .00283, so actual stationary pose replaces inaccurate commanded-pose gate for retreat only

changed_factors.name: handoff_latch
changed_factors.before: fresh Qwen goal veto after open and withdrawal can strand robot despite successful physical cleanup
changed_factors.after: initial goal true initiates atomic open/sensor-screened withdrawal/measured-open settled screened original home; no intermediate semantic veto; final fresh Qwen and independent goal/hand/home acceptance remain mandatory
changed_factors.reason: user requests purpose reached -> forced finish -> home; observed same wine images oscillate goal despite true independent goal. Recovery safety is separated from task-result acceptance, final failure still retained.

fixed_factors.homing: original joint_home controller, path screen and 360-sample streaming execution unchanged
fixed_factors.model: qwen3-vl-plus temperature0 actual RGB+synced encoders, no object oracle inputs

scope.stop_rule: 已保留8次最小运行；灶台成功不重跑。第9次仅wine，修正反复视觉重判中断已接受的收尾：首次目的信号触发原子恢复，安全门槛保持，最终任务独立验收不取消。不开组合/训练/子agent。
